types.note: Answering Satan, Jesus quotes Deuteronomy 8:3 — Israel's wilderness lesson: man lives by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
types.title: Forty days in the wilderness

types.note: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of Man be lifted up — looking brings life.
types.title: The serpent lifted up

types.note: As Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the fish, so the Son of Man three days in the heart of the earth.
types.title: The sign of Jonah

types.note: Paul names it outright: our passover also hath been sacrificed, even Christ.
types.title: Christ our passover

types.note: The crowd cites the manna; Jesus answers: I am the bread of life.
types.title: Bread from heaven

types.note: They drank of a spiritual rock that followed them: and the rock was Christ.
types.title: The spiritual Rock

types.note: Israel's passage through the sea was a baptism unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea.
types.title: Baptized unto Moses

types.note: The first man Adam became a living soul. The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
types.title: The last Adam

types.note: He spake of the temple of his body — God's dwelling place among men is now Christ himself.
types.title: The temple of his body

types.note: Philip opens Isaiah 53 at the eunuch's question — of whom speaketh the prophet this? — and preaches Jesus.
types.title: The suffering servant

types.note: The promise was spoken to Abraham's seed — singular — which is Christ.
types.title: The promised Seed

types.note: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of God Most High, becomes the pattern of Christ's priesthood.
types.title: A priest like Melchizedek

types.note: The way into the holy place runs through the veil, that is to say, his flesh.
types.title: Through the veil

types.note: As the sin offering was burned without the camp, Jesus suffered without the gate.
types.title: Outside the camp

types.note: Peter quotes Moses — God would raise up a prophet like him — and names Jesus.
types.title: The prophet like Moses

types.note: Jesus turns the psalm on the builders who rejected him: the stone became the head of the corner.
types.title: The rejected stone

types.note: Seeing the temple cleansed, the disciples remembered: zeal for thy house shall eat me up.
types.title: Zeal for thy house

types.note: Matthew sees Judas's thirty pieces of silver fulfilling Zechariah's wages.
types.title: Thirty pieces of silver

types.note: John quotes Zechariah at the cross: they shall look on him whom they pierced.
types.title: Him whom they pierced

types.note: The Passover regulation — neither shall ye break a bone thereof — kept in the crucifixion.
types.title: Not a bone broken

types.note: Hosea's 'out of Egypt did I call my son' is fulfilled in the flight to Egypt.
types.title: Out of Egypt

types.note: David calls the Messiah 'my Lord' — the Christ is greater than David's own son.
types.title: David's Lord
